friendlyInputs.label: Project Type
friendlyInputs.description: What kind of project are you creating?

options.label: TV Pilot (first episode of a new series)

friendlyInputs.label: Story Idea
friendlyInputs.description: Describe your story in a few sentences. What happens? Who are the main characters?
friendlyInputs.placeholder: Example: A retired detective receives a mysterious letter that leads her back to an unsolved case from 30 years ago. As she investigates, she discovers the truth hits closer to home than she ever imagined.

friendlyInputs.label: Working Title
friendlyInputs.description: A title for your project (we can generate one if you leave this blank)

friendlyInputs.label: Genre
friendlyInputs.description: What genre(s) is your project? You can list multiple separated by commas.

friendlyInputs.label: Mood / Tone
friendlyInputs.description: How should your project feel? What emotions should it evoke?
friendlyInputs.placeholder: Example: Dark and suspenseful, with moments of warmth

friendlyInputs.label: Target Audience
friendlyInputs.placeholder: Example: Adults 25-54, fans of crime dramas

friendlyInputs.label: Visual Style
friendlyInputs.description: How should your project look? This affects the generated concept art.
friendlyInputs.placeholder: Example: Cinematic noir, moody lighting, muted colors

friendlyInputs.label: Approximate Length
friendlyInputs.description: How long should your project be? Leave blank for a default based on project type.

friendlyInputs.label: Your Name
friendlyInputs.description: Your name for the screenplay credits

friendlyInputs.label: Additional Notes
friendlyInputs.description: Any other details, requirements, or creative direction
friendlyInputs.placeholder: Example: The story should be set in the Pacific Northwest. Include a subplot about family reconciliation.

inputs.label: Series Name
inputs.description: The name of the TV series

inputs.label: Season Number
inputs.description: Which season is this episode in?

inputs.label: Call to Action
inputs.description: What should viewers do after watching?
